Class InventoryManager

java.lang.Object
app.InventoryManager
public class InventoryManager extends Object
Manages the arena store's stock using an array of SalableProduct objects. The array holds different subclasses through Java inheritance.

  • Method Details

    • initializeInventory

      public void initializeInventory()
      Initializes the store inventory with weapons, armor, and health items. Each product contains a name, description, price, quantity, and an attribute specific to its product type.

    • getProductCount

      public int getProductCount()
      Returns the number of different products in the store.
      Returns:
      number of distinct products carried by the store

    • getProducts

      public SalableProduct[] getProducts()
      Returns a copy of the product-reference array for initializing the cart. Changes to returned array positions will not change inventory positions.
      Returns:
      shallow copy of available product references
